events.description: Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing, Monica Geller, Rachel Green, Phoebe Buffay, Ross Geller, and Joey Tribbiani are about to draw cards.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller does not need to draw any cards because Monica Geller has a straight.
Chandler Bing says Phoebe Buffay should decide how many cards Phoebe Buffay wants to draw.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay needs two cards—the ten of spades and the six of clubs.
Ross Geller says Phoebe Buffay cannot request specific cards during the game.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has the ten of spades and offers it to Phoebe Buffay.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green cannot give the ten of spades to Phoebe Buffay during the game.
Rachel Green says it is okay because Rachel Green does not need the ten of spades and the six of clubs and Rachel Green is going for fours.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller has prepared salmon roulettes and assorted crudités for Chandler Bing, Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, and Rachel Green.
Joey Tribbiani says Monica Geller is serving fancy food at a poker game and Joey Tribbiani says Monica Geller should serve simple items like chips, dip, or pretzels instead.

Monica Geller says Joey Tribbiani and Chandler Bing already know the rules and Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, Phoebe Buffay, Ross Geller, Chandler Bing, and Joey Tribbiani are going to play for real with high stakes.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller should be sure about proceeding to play for real.
Ross Geller says Phoebe Buffay threw away two jacks earlier because the jacks did not look happy.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is ready to play.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing should deal the cards now.
Chandler Bing says Monica Geller should deal the cards.
Phoebe Buffay says Joey Tribbiani was lying about how good Joey Tribbiani's cards were.
Joey Tribbiani says the question is whether Joey Tribbiani's cards were good.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani was bluffing.
Phoebe Buffay says bluffing is another word for lying.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is breaking up the poker conversation.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has resumes to fax before work tomorrow.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing, Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay need to settle the money for the poker game.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green wants to know what Chandler Bing, Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay need to settle regarding the poker game.
Chandler Bing says King George is giving Chandler Bing, Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller land for the Jamestown colony of Virginia.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green owes Ross Geller, Chandler Bing, and Joey Tribbiani money for the poker game.

Joey Tribbiani says because it is Phoebe Buffay's, Rachel Green's, and Monica Geller's first time playing, Chandler Bing, Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay should forget about the money.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay will pay what they owe.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay had another answer ready.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay want a rematch.
Ross Geller says a rematch is fine with Ross Geller and Ross Geller could use the money.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller gets his thrills by taking money from all of Ross Geller's friends.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing gets his thrills from Ikea items, which customers have to assemble themselves, but the items cost a little less.

Ross Geller says poker is competitive, Ross Geller plays to win, other people must lose, and if Rachel Green plays poker with Ross Geller, Rachel Green should not expect Ross Geller to be a nice guy once the cards are dealt.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is not a nice guy once the poker cards are dealt.
